name: twelve-point-eight-seven
why: Opens on "You have enough nuclear weapons to kill everyone thirteen times" as thirteen missiles queue for one Earth; every arsenal drops 1% and the mobile doesn't tilt, and the 1% lands exactly as tall as Valentine's Day while the heart patient dies of the candy.

name: very-expensive-paperweights
why: Opens on a missile paperweight blowing the INVESTMENTS to ash; the bridge grows a town while the missile grows cobwebs, the dog you can't walk eats $1.5 million and gets out, and the house of T.N.T. ends with neither a house nor T.N.T.

name: furniture-and-terror
why: Opens on "Terrorists: Kill fewer people than furniture accidents" as the dresser flattens one; the boot in the village makes the attackers, $8 trillion shoves the line up seventeen times under MISSION ACCOMPLISHED, and every arrow swings round to point at YOU.
